items.headline: German and Dutch ports hit by strikes
items.summary: German dockworkers began a 48-hour ver.di warning strike on September 2 after rejecting a 5.1% wage offer, while Dutch unions struck at Rotterdam, Amsterdam and Zeeland on September 4, compounding North European port congestion.

items.headline: CTRM software market sizing report released
items.summary: Commodity Technology Advisory's new report estimates the global CTRM software market reached $2.138 billion in 2026, forecasting growth to $2.452 billion by 2030 at a 3.6% CAGR.

items.headline: ACER updates REMIT inside-information reporting rules
items.summary: ACER revised its Manual of Procedures on Article 4 inside-information disclosure, introducing mandatory EIC codes and immutable UMM lifecycle updates, with firms given until December 2026 to adapt systems and processes.

items.headline: Trade finance blockchain adoption gains ground
items.summary: A Holland & Knight legal update notes blockchain, electronic transferable records, tokenized deposits and stablecoins are increasingly reducing fraud and paperwork in cross-border trade finance, though banks are favoring hybrid models over full replacement of legacy systems.
